name: pins-planning-appeal-outcome

source.publisher: Planning Inspectorate (PINS), GOV.UK publication 'Planning Inspectorate Casework Database', last updated 22 October 2026
source.mode: two anonymous bulk GETs; the build fails if the pinned bytes change
source.vintage_note: rolling database republished monthly-to-quarterly since March 2018; this build pins the 2026-10-22 edition, and every value is construction-time current-snapshot vintage - no historical vintages are claimed

grain: one row per decided s78_core planning-permission-family appeal (validated 2012-06-01..2026-08-21)

population.eligibility: publisher Type of Casework in the s78_core family (e.g. Planning Appeal, Householder (HAS)); Decision in {Allowed, Dismissed}; Received/Valid/Decision dates parseable and decision not before validation
population.deduplication: cross-file dedup on (type, LPA, received, valid, decision date, decision): 3,110 rows appear in BOTH publisher files with identical composites (2021 decisions) and are deduplicated; counted, never silently dropped
population.censoring: none beyond the publisher's own decided-cases-only extract (in progress, withdrawn and turned away cases are not in the source); the outcome-conditioned population is a property of the publisher's database, recorded as a limitation
population.frame_fidelity: the in-build per-decision-year fixture reproduces the discovery probe exactly for all 11 decision years (kept + counted exclusions == probe n; kept_allowed + excluded_allowed == probe allowed); flag presence verified by direct letter-based counts

splits.windows: temporal split on the validation instant (valid_date, the shipped time column): train < 2020-01-01, eval 2020-01-01..2021-12-31, holdout >= 2022-01-01 (through 2026-08-21); the outcome date cannot ship (post-instant), so the split key is the instant - the same construction as the published ipo (filed_date) and ec-merger (notification_date) tasks
splits.prevalence_shift_note: train 31.09% -> eval 30.13% -> holdout 31.43% positive: no material prevalence drift across splits; eval's two validation years are 0.2990 and 0.3036

runner_contract_probe.source: worker job pins-planning-002 stage 0 (category_probe.json), synthetic frames - no dataset row read, no metric computed

result.purpose: does the verbatim benchmark train.py predict path accept category-dtype columns at predict under the installed xgboost
result.model_config: XGBClassifier n_estimators=10 max_depth=3 lr=0.1 hist enable_categorical=True seed 42 - the verbatim train.py configuration modulo tree size
result.note: verdict rejected means build.py integer-codes the nine string-categorical columns so the shipped frame is int/float/bool only; no dataset row was read and no metric computed

runner_contract_probe.reading: the verbatim train.py predict path accepts category dtypes under xgboost 3.4.1, so the publisher's string levels ship verbatim; the only real breaker measured by baseline-001 was the object-dtype floor_space_sqm (6 eval rows of publisher prose), fixed by mapping unparseable prose to missing

qualification.source: worker job pins-planning-002, gate 1.5.0 on the full artifact on the worker
reaccepted_in: pins-planning-baseline-002 (re-fetched all five assets, every sha256 verified on arrival)
qualification.rebuild_note: this artifact is the ONE permitted rebuild (runner-compatibility defect class): pins-planning-001 (artifact 0cbb55fe..., staging 430070815) passed the gate but its baseline job pins-planning-baseline-001 failed at the verbatim train.py predict step on the 6 prose cells; train.csv and holdout.csv are sha256-identical between 001 and 002, eval.csv differs only in those 6 cells, and references reproduce 001's figures exactly

references.source: worker job pins-planning-002 score.py, post-acceptance, eval rows only (holdout never opened)
references.majority_note: majority fitted on train, measured against this split's labels

degenerate_controls_recorded.calendar_identity: collapsed onto lpa_hist_rate exactly: eval validation years (2020/2021) have no train-era valid-year support, so every eval row fell back to its LPA's train rate; paired diff 0.0, CI [0,0] - a collapsed control, never independent confirmation
degenerate_controls_recorded.year_rate_and_global_rate: constant scores, no ranking information (null AUC) - degenerate controls, recorded

lpa_clustered_bootstrap.unit: LPA (appeal outcomes of one planning authority are correlated)

references.persistence_note: measured, not declared not-applicable: every eval row's LPA has a train-era decided-case history for 92%+ of rows (the -1 sentinel marks the rest)
notes: the full model is NOT computed here; the harness runner's baseline job trains it on these same rows and its figure is quoted beside these references when it exists
lpa_hist_rate is the headroom reference named in the candidate record: a model must demonstrate headroom over it under this protocol for a positive verdict
persistence is measured, not declared not-applicable: every eval row's LPA has a train-era decided-case history for 92%+ of rows (the -1 sentinel marks the rest)
intervals containing zero are inconclusive differences, not parity

runner_baseline.source: worker job pins-planning-baseline-002: the benchmark's own train.py + validate.sh, bundled verbatim (sha256 equal the read-only clone's; unmodified: true)
runner_baseline.scope: one baseline through the runner's existing training and validation contract; no agent or harness comparison was run and none is implied; the holdout was never copied into any workdir

model_vs_reference_comparison.source: worker job pins-planning-baseline-002 (model_intervals.py), derived evidence on the identical eval rows after the verbatim contract run
model_vs_reference_comparison.model: XGBClassifier n_estimators=30 max_depth=6 lr=0.1 hist seed 42 - identical to the verbatim train.py baseline; string columns with >1000 levels dropped exactly as the baseline drops them
model_vs_reference_comparison.interpretation: every paired interval excludes zero under both the row-level and the LPA-clustered protocol: demonstrated headroom over every measured simple reference under this protocol (procedure-type rate 0.5551, LPA history rate 0.5414, shipped rate feature 0.5422; persistence 0.5045; degenerate calendar control). One model configuration, no re-tuning, two validation years of eval coverage - an observed result, not a bound on other models
model_vs_reference_comparison.replication_note: the references are reimplemented here independently (pandas groupby), not imported from the build job's score.py; the shipped_rate_feature reference scores the artifact's own lpa_allow_rate_prior column, cross-checking the LPA-rate implementation (0.5422 vs 0.5414). The model figure is quoted from the verbatim runner contract run, not independently rerun.
limitations: one model configuration with no re-tuning
two validation years of eval coverage
the calendar-identity control was degenerate (collapsed onto the LPA rate), so seasonality/identity headroom is not independently established
the model's per-validation-year AUC and Brier were not computed; per-year figures exist for the references only
notes: the references are reimplemented here independently (pandas groupby), not imported from the build job's score.py
shipped_rate_feature scores the artifact's own lpa_allow_rate_prior column; its agreement with lpa_hist_rate cross-checks the reference
intervals containing zero are inconclusive differences, not parity

scope_note: All figures computed on temporary workers after exact-byte acceptance of artifact c861bd8f4acd9bbe267bdb58e1168996fdb359c540aaf4030030a632d693c527; the holdout was never opened by any scoring stage and stays sealed. The cross-row exposure (LPA-history features embedding other rows' labels) means honest evaluation requires isolated rows - a requirement the shipped illustrative runner does not enforce.
